alignment_contract.dataset_semantics: obs[t] is the pre-action observation; actions[t] is the command applied from that observation. Stored arrays are equal length; only T-1 transitions have a recorded successor observation.

    "env_name": "Lift",
    "type": 1,
    "env_kwargs": {
        "has_renderer": false,

                -0.5,

                0,
                300
            ],

}
